column1: VLCC Fleet Ranking Snapshots — Methodology-Aware Benchmark

Ranking rule: preserve the source methodology. A fleet ranking may count owned, operated, beneficially controlled or commercially controlled tonnage differently. Sanctions and other restrictions are filters, not ownership attributes. The same company can therefore have different valid fleet counts at different dates or under different definitions.
